Webmaster Portal

Simplified age verification for your website

Prevent minors from accessing prohibited content with a free solution to verify and estimate the age of your visitors.

Certification IEEE 2089.1–2024

Standard for Online Age Verification

Certification IEEE 2089.1–2024

Standard for Online Age Verification

Comply with regulatory requirements relating to the age of your visitors

Regulations to protect minors on the Internet are steadily increasing

AgeVerif is a service that enables websites to comply with regulations and guidelines designed to protect minors from accessing age-restricted content.

Age verification is now essential to protect your business and online activities

Integrate transparent and secure age verification methods that prioritize the privacy of your visitors' data and the fluidity of the user experience.

Simple, fast and anonymous verification methods

A wide range of free and pay solutions for all geographical zones

  • AI-powered biometric analysis
  • Double-anonymous age estimation via a third-party application
  • Double anonymity identity verification via a third-party application
  • Micro transaction by 3D Secure credit card
AgeVerif authentication

Once the verification is complete, users register their age attestation in their AgeVerif account secured with a Passkey. This allows them to authenticate themselves in seconds on all websites and services using AgeVerif.

Methods pricing

Each of the methods listed below is optional and can be enabled or disabled in your Webmaster portal based on the geolocation of the users you want to verify.

The prices shown are charged for each of your users who have successfully completed the verification process.

  • AgeGO : 0,015 €
  • AgeKey : 0 €
  • AgeKey Verifier : 0,015 €
  • AnonymAGE : 0 €
  • Credit Card : 0 €
  • France Identité (EUDI Wallet): 0 €
  • AgeVerif Account : 0 €
  • PayPal : 0 €
  • Pleenk : 0,04 €
  • Selfie : 0 €
  • AgeVerif Ticket * : 0 €
  • Yoti Digital ID : 0 €
  • Yoti Key : 0,015 €
* Only in France
  • Double anonymity
    With a double-anonymity method, the user verifies his age with a third-party partner who then sends us age attestation without us knowing the verification data.
  • Passkey
    At the end of each verification method, users are prompted to save their age attestation in their AgeVerif account and create an access key to strengthen the security of their account and age attestation.
  • Choice
    A user who has the choice can easily find the verification method that suits them, which reduces verification constraints.
  • Flexibility
    Our methods adapt to your visitors' geolocation and local regulations.
Multilingual methods that adapt to your visitors' location and respect their privacy

Security - Speed - Confidentiality

Designed to protect your visitors' privacy and guarantee a frictionless user experience

Fast, anonymous processing of your visitors On computer, tablet or mobile, it only takes a few minutes for a user to have their majority validated with AgeVerif and be given an age attestation that can be reused on all websites using our solution.

  • Transparent verification methods, including double anonymity to enhance the privacy of your visitors

  • Compliance with the GDPR and the regulations in force on the processing of personal data

  • Strong authentication of AgeVerif users with the creation of a Passkey at the end of age verification

  • Data security with bank-level 256-bit SSL encryption of all information exchanged between your visitors and AgeVerif

  • AgeVerif does not use your visitors' data for commercial purposes (emailing, resale, rental, sharing with third parties, etc.).

  • AgeVerif verified users are never associated with sites that request age verification.

Ready-to-use integration

Focus on your core business, save resources and time - we'll take care of the rest.

  • Create your AgeVerif Webmaster account and install our free solution on your website.
  • In just 5 minutes and with a single line of code, your site is ready to check the age of your visitors.
  • Advanced integration via our Javascript API for detailed control of service operation.
  • A multilingual solution fully integrated into your website, designed with your visitors in mind.
  • Offer your visitors a choice of quick and easy age verification methods.
  • A smooth, seamless user experience with no pop-ups, new pages or tabs.
  • Activation options for all pages of your site, a specific page or a user action.
  • Easily choose the geolocation of the visitors to your site you want to check.

  • Detailed documentation with step-by-step guides and code examples. View the documentation

Automate the age verification of your visitors
Installing AgeVerif on your website is entirely free.
